title: nagori snap (v1)
description: Schema defining a 'snap'—a lightweight, raw thought fragment (Max ~320 bytes) recorded by a human.

v.description: Protocol Version identifier (n1 = nagori specification v1)

t.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the fragment was recorded

n.description: Temporary mask/alias name (Max 15 characters, ~45 bytes in UTF-8)

p.description: Preamble / Preface context (Max 20 characters, ~60 bytes in UTF-8)

b.description: Main body text of the thought fragment (Max ~140 bytes in UTF-8)

s.description: Postscript / Sign-off tag (Max 10 characters, ~30 bytes in UTF-8)
